terrainDescription.zh: 「千丘之國」，地形以丘陵與火山為主，人口密度高
terrainDescription.en: The "Land of a Thousand Hills" — hilly, volcanic terrain with high population density

historicalContext.zh: 1994年種族滅絕後推動國家重建與和解政策，近年城市基礎建設發展快速，不宜用路況判斷國家發展階段。
historicalContext.en: Since the 1994 genocide, national reconciliation policy has driven rapid urban infrastructure development — road quality shouldn't be used to gauge development stage.

note.zh: Imigongo（黑白紅幾何圖案的牆面/器皿裝飾藝術）是盧安達特有的傳統藝術形式，若在建築牆面或紀念品店看到，是中等強度的辨識線索。
note.en: Imigongo (black/white/red geometric wall and craft art) is a distinctively Rwandan traditional art form — a medium-strength clue if visible on walls or in craft shops.

culturalMarkers.caveat: Architecture/craft, not clothing — reasonably distinctive when present
